original_state_selection: The prior source handoff records CSAttack::OnFocus at 0x3c404c selecting CharAnimTable Attack field+4 only when predecessor state is4 (Move), otherwise AttackStatic field+8. It adds GetAnimStance (0x3a53e0) only when the corresponding stanced-list mask bit is enabled: 0x40 for moving Attack, 0x80 for AttackStatic.

Rogue dual-wield stance2 selects moving root250 Human_Attack_02_Dual and static root245 Human_AttackStatic_02_Dual. Both roots are Type1, Loop0 and contain four ordered authored groups with three leaves each; moving redirects to 167-170 and static to 171-174.

Mage Staff stance3 selects moving root251 Human_Attack_03_Staff and static root246 Human_AttackStatic_03_Staff. Both are Type1, Loop0 and redirect through 651 / 654 to the same authored wand clip ID1218, data/3D/characters/prince/animations/skill_dh2_prince_mage_wand_attack.bdae. This visual table data alone does not establish that Mage input should be admitted as melee or projectile combat.
command_admission: The prior IDA handoff records v2Controller::Cmd_Attack at 0x405b04 applying blocked/locked gates before the controllable virtual call, Character::Ctrl_Attack at 0x3ad87c calling AI_DoMeleeAttack at 0x3d01ac, and source dead/attack-enabled/range gates in that path.

This feature does not create or admit commands. The existing combo planner accepts an already-resolved equipment stance and explicit predecessor state; this bank helper invokes it once with predecessor4 and once with predecessor3 so the production caller can use its own current-state choice.
logic_evidence.existing_consumers: RuntimePlayerComboChainV1 reads the source AnimTable and animation dictionary and produces OriginalCombatVisualPlan sequences, named clips, policies and rates. OriginalAttackSequence/CombatSession remain owners of playback, markers and results. CharacterVisualConfig clips must be installed before CharacterVisual::load; root owns the CombatSession optional-bank integration and hand-marker policy.
logic_evidence.implementation_boundary: The new helper combines the two exact state banks only when profile ID, model path, role, clip aliases and authored rates are compatible. It keeps profile visual configuration and skin, rejects a Knight profile fallback, returns source Type/Loop policies, and creates no RNG choice, input request, hit outcome, target change, marker routing or Mage combat classification.

expected_behavior: When the production caller has an admitted attack request, its own predecessor state chooses this profile's moving Attack or AttackStatic bank. Rogue dual-dagger and Mage staff state roots resolve from their actual class CharAnimTable and equipment stance; authored source order, clip URIs, rates, blend values, MoveGO values, Type, Loop and redirects remain intact. This helper supplies a same-profile pre-load bank; it does not claim the bank is integrated or the class attack is playable.
